sections.name: SECTIONS
sections.title: Gallery component checks
sections.what: Checks that every gallery section shows, the ticket locks with the keyboard, the receipt opens, and the page passes accessibility checks in light and dark mode.
sections.why: Covers the shared components in the two themes users can choose.
sections.watch_out: The ticket test expects a specific starting value of 60, so changing the default breaks it.

summary: Browser tests of the design gallery page, which shows every shared visual component, checking they appear, work with the keyboard, and pass accessibility checks in both themes.
purpose: Keeps the shared visual parts working and accessible, since every page reuses them.
why: A broken shared component would break many pages at once, so the gallery acts as an early warning.
how: The first test checks all eight component sections are visible, that the AI analyst label appears five times, and that the meter shows a low value. The ticket test selects an option, confirms the confidence slider starts at 60, moves it with the arrow key, locks the call with the keyboard, and checks it becomes disabled. The receipt test opens a source drawer. The final loop runs the accessibility checker in light and dark mode.
inputs: The design gallery page and its components.
outputs: Pass or fail for visibility, keyboard behaviour, the receipt drawer and accessibility.
risks: The count of five AI analyst labels is fixed, so adding a persona to the gallery breaks the test.
debug: If the count is wrong, compare the gallery page with the expected number. If the keyboard steps fail, check focus and the lock button.
